description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This vital leadership role supports the Director of Nursing in overseeing clinical operations, ensuring the highest standards of patient care, and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff. If you are a compassionate leader with a passion for quality healthcare, we encourage you to apply.The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in staff supervision, policy implementation, and maintaining regulatory compliance. This position offers a competitive salary and the opportunity to make a significant impact on the lives of our residents. We are looking for a professional who is ready to contribute to a team-oriented and supportive work environment.
requirements: Previous experience in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting
Demonstrated leadership or supervisory experience in nursing
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
Knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $60,000 to $75,000, based on experience and qualifications.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Marketing Director to join our dynamic team. This is a fully remote opportunity, offering the flexibility to work from anywhere while contributing to a growing healthcare organization. You will be instrumental in shaping our brand presence and driving strategic marketing initiatives.

As Marketing Director, you will be responsible for developing and executing comprehensive marketing strategies to enhance brand visibility, engage target audiences, and support organizational growth objectives. This role requires a proactive leader with a strong understanding of the healthcare landscape and digital marketing trends.

This full-time position offers an annual salary range of $70,000 - $80,000. We are actively scheduling interviews Monday through Friday from 1 PM to 7 PM, with weekend availability as needed, to accommodate qualified candidates.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field
Proven experience in a marketing leadership role, preferably within the healthcare sector
Strong understanding of digital marketing, brand management, and market analysis
Excellent strategic planning, communication, and interpersonal skills
Ability to work effectively and independently in a remote environment
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $70,000 - $80,000, based on experience.
